newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish end-August EBR 85 mln punts - Finance Dept.
newsitem.headline: Irish end-August EBR 85 mln punts - Finance Dept.

text.p: Ireland's end-August Exchequer Borrowing Requirement (EBR) totalled 85 million Irish pounds compared with 524 million at the end of August last year, the Department of Finance said on Tuesday.
The government's full-year EBR target is 729 million Irish pounds or two percent of GNP.
Total tax receipts in the eight months to end-August came to 8.07 billion Irish pounds versus 7.22 billion a year earlier.
Miscellaneous revenue totalled 295.02 million punts versus 238.93 million last year, while other receipts came to 188.05 million versus 223.68 million.

On the spending side, central fund issues came to 2.07 billion versus 1.89 billion, and supply services issues came to 6.72 billion versus 6.44 billion last year. Other issues totalled 28.99 million versus 16.91 million a year ago.
